data.heading: 4-mashq — harakat fe'llarini ishlatib qayta yozing
data.problem: Quyidagi gaplarni harakat fe'llari bilan qayta yozing va atayin qilingan xatoni toping:

steps.text: Populations of some bird species in South Asia have crashed by 97% in recent years. The number of cases of death by poisoning has increased sharply.
In 2007 the child mortality rate fell to lower than 60 deaths per 1,000.
The average family car in the UK goes down in value by 20% per year. This means its value has fallen by more than half after just three years.
A typical piece of land on the edge of the city will go up in value by 15% per year, and house prices have gone up rapidly by a large amount in the last six months.
Business courses have increased greatly in number while science programmes have gone down.
The temperature rose higher than 45°C in some parts of the country. See the figure 3.

narr: Bu mashqda sizga harakat fe'llarini qo'llash kerak edi va atayin qilingan xatoni topish talab qilindi.
Birinchi javobda 'plummeted' so'zi 'soar' fe'lining antonimi bo'lib, qulab tushish degan ma'noni anglatadi.
Ikkinchi javobda 'fell below' ifodasi 60 dan past bo'lishini anglatadi.
Uchinchi javobda 'depreciates' so'zi qiymatning kamayishini anglatadi.
To'rtinchi javobda 'appreciates' so'zi qiymatning oshishini anglatadi.
Beshinchi javobda 'multiplied' va 'declined' so'zlari sonning ko'payishi va kamayishini anglatadi.
Oltinchi javobda 'exceeded' so'zi oshib ketish degan ma'noni anglatadi.

data.heading: 4-mashq — harakat fe'llarini ishlatib qayta yozing (cont.)

steps.text: Between 1983 and 2006, the number of this species of eagle went up from 22 pairs to 58. Other bird populations have gone up to twice the number in the same period.
The numbers of old soldiers attending regimental reunions are becoming smaller each year.

data.result: Javoblar: (1) have plummeted by 97%; the number of cases has soared; (2) fell below 60 deaths per 1,000; (3) depreciates by 20% per year; its value has more than halved after just three years; (4) appreciates by 15% per year; house prices have soared in the last six months; (5) business courses have multiplied while science programmes have declined; (6) the temperature exceeded 45°C; atayin qilingan xato: See the figure 3 → See Figure 3; (7) rose from 22 pairs to 58; other bird populations have doubled; (8) are declining each year

narr: Yettinchi javobda 'doubled' so'zi ikki barobar oshish degan ma'noni anglatadi.
Sakkizinchi javobda 'are declining' so'zi kamayib borayotganini anglatadi.
Xato topildi: 'See the figure 3' → 'See Figure 3' - artikl qo'shish kerak emas.

data.heading: Amaliy mashg'ulot — statista.com saytidagi grafikni tasvirlash
data.problem: Statista saytiga kirib, grafik tanlang va uni lug'at so'zlari bilan tasvirlang:

steps.text: To'liq tavsif pocket-money namunasiga amal qiladi:

data.result: The line graph presents data relating to passenger numbers on the city metro. The y axis or vertical axis shows the number of passengers per month, and the x axis or horizontal axis indicates the months of the year. From the graph we can see that passenger numbers rose steadily from January to June and reached a peak in July. After that, they declined slightly, and by December they had fallen to the January level. This decline can be explained by the fact that the universities were on holiday.

narr: Bu amaliy mashg'ulotda siz Statista saytida grafik tanlab, uni ingliz tilida tasvirlashingiz kerak edi.
Misol javobida chiziqli grafik shahar metro yo'lovchilar sonini ko'rsatadi.
Vertikal o'y (y oqi) oylik yo'lovchilar sonini, gorizontal o'y (x oqi) esa yil oylarini ko'rsatadi.
Grafikdan ko'rinib turibdiki, yo'lovchilar soni yanvardan iyulgacha barqaror o'sib, iyul oyida cho'qqiga chiqadi.
Keyin ular biroz kamayadi, dekabr oyiga kelib yanvar darajasiga tushadi.
Bu kamayish universitetlar dam olishda bo'lganligi bilan tushuntirilishi mumkin.

data.heading: TED Talk: How to Spot a Misleading Graph — tinglab tushunish
data.problem: Asosiy mazmunni tinglab suhbat bo'yicha savollarga javob bering:

steps.text: Savol 1: Videoning asosiy mavzusi nima?
Savol 2: Suhbatchi grafiklar haqida odamlar odatda qanday fikrda ekanligini aytadi?
Savol 3: Suhbatchining yakuniy maslahati nima?
Savol 4: Grafik chalg'itishi mumkin bo'lgan ikki usulni nomlang.

data.result: Javoblar: (1) b) How graphs can mislead people, and how to spot it; (2) c) People tend to trust them more than a plain claim, even though they can be manipulated; (3) c) Look carefully at the labels, numbers, scale, and context, and ask what story the graph is telling; (4) Suhbatdan namunaviy javoblar: (1) vertikal o'q yaqinlashtirilishi yoki kesib tashlanishi mumkin; (2) yorliqlar, raqamlar, masshtab yoki kontekst o'zgartirilishi mumkin

narr: Bu mashqda siz TED Talk videosini tinglab, berilgan savollarga javob berishingiz kerak edi.
Birinchi savolga javob: grafiklar odamlarni chalg'itishi va bu chalg'itishni qanday aniqlash mumkinligi haqida.
Ikkinchi savolga javob: odamlar grafiklarga oddiy da'vogardan ko'ra ko'proq ishonadilar, hatto ular manipulyatsiya qilingan bo'lishi mumkinligiga qaramay.
Uchinchi savolga javob: yorliqlar, raqamlar, masshtab va kontekstga ehtiyotkorlik bilan qarang va grafik qanday hikoya aytayotganini har doim so'rang.
To'rtinchi savolga javob: grafik chalg'itishi mumkin bo'lgan ikkita usul - vertikal o'qni manipulyatsiya qilish va yorliqlarni, raqamlarni, masshtabni yoki kontekstni o'zgartirish.
Endi biz sabab-oqibat tashilashni o'rganamiz.
Bu bo'limda har bir gapni to'ldirish uchun eng mos fe'lni tanlash kerak.
